$description: Anchoring examples shown to the planner LLM. Grow this file (never Python) to teach the planner about new kinds of apps. Each entry composes primitives + declares archetypes (recipes or capability compositions) + runtime_context. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-11-intelligent-rich-forge.md. Every value here MUST be in the shipped vocabularies (shapes/vocabulary.json, archetypes/capability_vocabulary.json, runtime/context_vocabulary.json) — these entries are shown to the planner, so a value the validator rejects teaches it to emit one. Add the term to the vocabulary first, then use it here.
